episodes.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                       (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                              (r0 (fst bb))
                              (c0 (snd bb))
                              (r1 (nth bb 2))
                              (c1 (nth bb 3))
                              (bh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
                              (bw (+ 1 (- c1 c0)))
                              (outer (at g r0 c0))
                              (inner-vals (filter (lambda (v)
                                                    (and (!= v 0) (!= v outer)))
                                                  (map (lambda (p)
                                                         (at g (fst p) (snd p)))
                                                       (obj-cells obj))))
                              (inner (if (empty? inner-vals) outer (fst inner-vals)))
                              (th (quotient bh 2))
                              (tw (quotient bw 2))
                              (oh (if (zero? (remainder bh 2)) (* 2 bh) (- (* 2 bh) 1)))
                              (ow (if (zero? (remainder bw 2)) (* 2 bw) (- (* 2 bw) 1)))
                              (tr (- r0 th))
                              (tc (- c0 tw)))
                         (reduce (lambda (a rr)
                                   (reduce (lambda (aa cc)
                                             (let* ((gr (+ tr rr))
                                                    (gc (+ tc cc))
                                                    (in-inner (and
                                                                (>= rr th)
                                                                (< rr (- oh th))
                                                                (>= cc tw)
                                                                (< cc (- ow tw))))
                                                    (inner-border (and
                                                                    in-inner
                                                                    (or
                                                                      (= rr th)
                                                                      (= rr (- oh th 1))
                                                                      (= cc tw)
                                                                      (= cc (- ow tw 1)))))
                                                    (inner-core (and
                                                                  in-inner
                                                                  (not inner-border)))
                                                    (outer-band (or
                                                                  (and
                                                                    (< rr th)
                                                                    (>= cc tw)
                                                                    (< cc (- ow tw)))
                                                                  (and
                                                                    (>= rr (- oh th))
                                                                    (>= cc tw)
                                                                    (< cc (- ow tw)))
                                                                  (and
                                                                    (< cc tw)
                                                                    (>= rr th)
                                                                    (< rr (- oh th)))
                                                                  (and
                                                                    (>= cc (- ow tw))
                                                                    (>= rr th)
                                                                    (< rr (- oh th))))))
                                               (cond
                                                 ((not (in-bounds? gr gc h w)) aa)
                                                 (inner-border (set-cell aa gr gc inner))
                                                 (inner-core (set-cell aa gr gc outer))
                                                 (outer-band (set-cell aa gr gc outer))
                                                 (else aa))))
                                           a
                                           (range 0 ow)))
                                 acc
                                 (range 0 oh))))
                     (cellmap g (r c v) 0)
                     objs)))))
